items.title: Capital One (COF) Faces Zelle Fraud Lawsuit As It Settles Canada Data Breach Case
items.summary: Capital One Financial (NYSE:COF) has been named in a major lawsuit tied to alleged fraud involving the Zelle payments network. The company is identified as a co-owner of Zelle in the case, which focuses on consumer losses linked to disputed transactions. Separately, Capital One agreed to a C$35 million settlement in a Canadian class action related to a prior data breach.
